notes: The same real-geometry 3DBAG slice split into one file per feature. This is a filesystem-heavy layout case for open/close overhead, metadata lookup, and random-access behavior.
preprocessing: Run the shared 3DBAG acquisition script in cityjson-corpus.
Export the published raw CityJSON tile as JSONL with cjio.
Split the validated JSONL stream into metadata.json and one feature file per CityJSONFeature.
reference: Use `just acquire-3dbag` in cityjson-corpus to split the pinned JSONL stream into one file per feature.
